analysis: The only change in docs/architecture/inference.md is a documentation addition at head lines 456-468. It describes NAX kernels for routed NVFP4 experts and dense FP8/NVFP4 projections on M5+ GPUs. It also describes GPU submission of speculative verify windows every 12 blocks and fused MTP decode kernels. It adds env knobs DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP_WINDOW_SUBMIT and DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP_FUSION. The supplied base units (lines 1233-1752) are unchanged surrounding context for a different part of the doc; they describe vision, MiMo and Qwen4 admission, which this PR does not touch. The change is documentation only. It introduces no code, endpoint, key handling, wire protocol, cache storage or authorization change, so it does not alter A-001, A-003, the TB-002, TB-007 or TB-011 controls, or the T-041 prefix-cache posture (SSD tier, HMAC names, TTL, scope). The added text does not touch the prefix-cache or at-rest artifacts or the scope derivation. It asserts the kernels change summation order but not accuracy, and that the env knobs do not change tokens. These correctness claims come from libs/mlx-swift-lm/docs/nemotron-super.md and the matching code, which were not supplied. They are unverified here, and they affect correctness and qualification, not an identifiable security boundary. If the actual PR also ships kernel or code changes, those need a separate review. No concrete security regression is identified from the supplied evidence.
